invariants: Decision snapshots are append-only canonical UTF-8 LF JSONL records.
A rerun with the same decision_cutoff, run_id and pair is idempotent and may not duplicate a record.
Every usable input has available_at <= decision_cutoff; an unknown or late input is persisted as WITHHELD.
Decision snapshots never contain a forward return, outcome, cost realization or target label.
Outcomes are appended in a separate store and joined only by snapshot_id.
The logger is observational: it must not alter Core scoring, bias, sizing, eligibility, pair state or dashboard output.
